subject.title: feat: configure model providers from the Control UI settings page

question: Should OpenClaw core expose provider credential mutation, targeted logout, live provider probes, and default-model editing together in the Control UI through the new gateway surface?
rationale: The implementation adds a substantial user-facing auth/config control plane and an admin-scoped protocol method; tests can validate mechanics, but only maintainers can confirm that this combined scope belongs in core and is ready to become a supported product contract.

options.title: Sponsor after isolation and proof
options.body: Accept the combined core direction once probe bookkeeping is isolated and redacted real-provider evidence covers the credential, logout, probe, and default-model flows.

options.title: Narrow the first landing
options.body: Land only credential visibility and safe API-key management, deferring probes, targeted logout, or default-model editing to smaller follow-up changes.

options.title: Keep configuration CLI-first
options.body: Decline the new Control UI control plane and retain the existing CLI and raw settings workflows as the supported provider-management path.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after isolation and proof
recommendation.body: Accept the combined core direction once probe bookkeeping is isolated and redacted real-provider evidence covers the credential, logout, probe, and default-model flows.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the existing probe implementation and the adjacent Control UI/product surface.
